integrity: General proof via constrained two-factor matrix decompositions; exhaustive exact-arithmetic checks for eight finite cases. Existing global rank spectrum and zero fiber are credited, not claimed new.
scientific_limitations: Rank-one sandwich matrix over a finite field, m,n>=2. No independent validation, unproved historical priority, no higher-rank sandwich case or scheme-theoretic fibers.
title: Prescribed commutator fibers of rank-one matrix sandwich semigroups
